degradation_contract.required_downstream_mapping: Map degradation to an actual PyBaMM chemistry/aging representation before physical claims are made.

scenarios.name: Normal Operation
scenarios.description: Healthy 100-cell pack under nominal declared conditions; all cells are evaluated.
scenarios.prediction_intent: Evaluate health/state of every cell and establish the healthy reference distribution.

scenarios.name: High Charging Stress
scenarios.description: Charging rate increased while the whole 100-cell pack is scanned for cell-level divergence.
scenarios.matched_healthy_reference: S1 with identical ambient temperature and healthy pack state
scenarios.prediction_intent: Evaluate every cell for electrical/thermal/state deviation rather than assuming a predetermined fault location.

scenarios.name: High Ambient Temperature
scenarios.description: Ambient temperature elevated while keeping charging control matched to S1; every cell is evaluated.
scenarios.matched_healthy_reference: S1 with identical charge rate and healthy pack state
scenarios.prediction_intent: Evaluate whether any subset of cells develops abnormal thermal/electrical state under elevated ambient conditions.

scenarios.name: Localized Degradation Detection
scenarios.description: Detect degradation anywhere in the 100-cell pack. Cell 37 is retained only as the controlled benchmark injection case.
scenarios.matched_healthy_reference: Same 100-cell operating condition without injected/known degradation
scenarios.prediction_intent: Identify which cell or cells deviate from the validated healthy reference without assuming Cell 37.

scenarios.name: Combined High-Risk Scenario
scenarios.description: Combine cell-specific degradation with elevated charging and ambient temperature; scan all 100 cells for direct and propagated effects.
scenarios.matched_healthy_reference: Matched healthy 100-cell pack under the same operating controls
scenarios.prediction_intent: Localize defective cells, currently affected cells, and potentially affected cells from whole-pack multi-physics evidence.

scenarios.name: Intervention / What-If Recovery
scenarios.description: Inherit S5 cell-specific state and evaluate candidate control changes while scanning all cells again.
scenarios.prediction_intent: Determine how intervention changes per-cell trajectories and whether risk/localization changes over the full forecast horizon.

s6_intervention_sweep.selection_rule: After validated constraints are available, choose the highest tested C-rate satisfying all applicable validated constraints over the complete forecast horizon. Otherwise emit NO_FEASIBLE_TESTED_CANDIDATE.
s6_intervention_sweep.invariance_assertion: Each S6 candidate must inherit the exact S5 per-cell degradation state, affected-cell set, ambient temperature, initial SOC, cooling state and other physical state. Only declared intervention controls may change.

cell_localization_experiment.benchmark_purpose: Known-location controlled degradation for localization validation
cell_localization_experiment.trigger_policy: Any validated trigger initiates a whole-pack evaluation across Cells 1-100.

classification_definitions.DEFECTIVE: A validated defect criterion is crossed for the cell.
classification_definitions.AFFECTED: Current validated evidence shows abnormal or degraded behavior, but the declared defect criterion is not crossed.
classification_definitions.POTENTIALLY_AFFECTED: Forecast or cross-cell evidence indicates elevated future risk within the declared evaluation horizon.
classification_definitions.HEALTHY: No validated current or forecast abnormality is detected under the declared evaluation criteria.
classification_definitions.UNASSESSED: Required data, model, or threshold validation is unavailable.

cell37_experiment.purpose: Controlled known-location benchmark within the general whole-pack localization framework.
cell37_experiment.controlled_difference: Only the declared degradation state differs between the matched healthy and degraded Cell 37 cases.
cell37_experiment.hypothesis: Under matched operating controls, a controlled degradation applied to Cell 37 should produce measurable cell-level differences relative to its matched healthy reference, and the whole-pack localization system should infer the affected location from cell-level evidence rather than from a hard-coded Cell 37 rule.

legacy_draft_thresholds.mapping_rule: Historical draft values must not be assigned to radial stress, tangential stress, concentration, SOH, or any operational threshold without an authoritative source and chemistry/model applicability.

action_rules.activation_condition: Only applicable after risk thresholds, precedence, and boundary definitions are validated.

early_warning_spec.conventional_alarm_definition: Alarm time is the earliest time a validated conventional measurement threshold is crossed.
early_warning_spec.predictive_alarm_definition: Alarm time is the earliest forecast time at which a validated physical boundary is predicted to be crossed under the declared event rule.
early_warning_spec.event_matching: A predicted event matches a ground-truth event when both refer to the same domain, cell, and threshold crossing within a declared time tolerance.
early_warning_spec.no_event_handling: If no ground-truth event occurs, alarm classification follows an explicitly declared no-event rule; lead time is UNDEFINED when no breach occurs.
early_warning_spec.alarm_precedence: Earliest valid violation within the declared domain/cell/threshold precedence hierarchy.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: The V1 surrogate should reproduce held-out nominal trajectories within predefined prediction-error tolerances.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Proposed target: solid-particle concentration relative L2 error <= 2% on the declared held-out evaluation set; other outputs require separately declared tolerances.
scientific_objectives.evidence_required: Held-out PyBaMM ground truth and documented evaluation procedure.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: Changing charging severity should measurably alter relevant thermal, electrochemical, and mechanical trajectories under otherwise matched conditions.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Effect size and direction must be estimated from matched PyBaMM cases; no monotonicity claim is assumed in Notebook 03.
scientific_objectives.evidence_required: Matched scenarios with controlled C-rate changes.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: Changing ambient temperature should measurably alter thermal trajectories under otherwise matched conditions.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Observed change must be quantified against a matched healthy baseline; no linearity claim is assumed.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: Localized degradation applied to an arbitrary declared cell or cell set within Cells 1-100 should produce measurable cell-level divergence from matched healthy references, without requiring the inference system to know the fault location in advance.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Test whether the degraded cell or cell set shows divergence outside a statistically defined healthy-reference envelope and whether localization is recovered from cell-level evidence. Cell 37 is a controlled known-location benchmark only; no 3-sigma rule is established in Notebook 03.
scientific_objectives.evidence_required: Repeated healthy/degraded cases across declared cell locations, matched operating controls, explicit reference-distribution estimation, and cell-level ground-truth labels.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: Combined localized degradation, ambient stress, and high charging can produce measurable changes in predicted safety-envelope trajectories.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Threshold-crossing time error target <= 10% is proposed and must be tested against numerical ground truth.
scientific_objectives.evidence_required: Validated boundaries, matched simulation ground truth, and cell-level localization evidence.

scientific_objectives.scientific_hypothesis: A counterfactual reduction in charging rate may restore or improve validated safety margins while preserving the inherited S5 cell-state configuration.
scientific_objectives.proposed_acceptance_criteria: Select the highest tested candidate satisfying all validated constraints over the full forecast horizon; otherwise return NO_FEASIBLE_TESTED_CANDIDATE.
scientific_objectives.evidence_required: Full-horizon candidate simulations, validated constraints, and all-cell rescan results.
